Meet Chat Smith, your next-generation AI assistant built to think deeper, create faster, and help you achieve more. Powered by the world’s most advanced models Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.2, GPT-5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini Flash 3.5, DeepSeek V4, and Grok-4.5, Chat Smith combines human-like reasoning with powerful AI chat capabilities.

Whether you need an AI writer, a coding expert, or a deep research tool, Chat Smith is the all-in-one productivity assistant designed to simplify your life.

SMITH CO-WORK AGENT
Our new AI agent, Daily Smith, helps you stay productive by managing meetings, emails, tasks, and daily priorities in one place - so you can focus on what matters most.

AI IMAGE GENERATOR
Create stunning AI images in seconds! Using GPT Image 2.0, Gemini Nano Banana Pro, Chat Smith Text to Image, and advanced text-to-image technology, Chat Smith turns your prompts or photos into eye-catching AI artwork and high-quality visuals.  

AI WRITING ASSISTANT
Generate outlines or paragraphs with an AI essay writer, and craft narratives with an AI story generator built on advanced models GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini Flash 3.5, DeepSeek V4, and Grok-4.5.  

DEEP RESEARCH
Unlock deeper insights with Pro Search and Deep Research powered by advanced AI reasoning. Get accurate answers with sources, citations, and updated reports — perfect for students, analysts, and researchers seeking clarity beyond surface-level information.  

VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
Stay productive with an AI assistant that helps you plan tasks, organize ideas, and get things done faster. With instant, reliable answers powered by GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini Flash 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5, DeepSeek V4, and Grok-4.5, Chat Smith makes every workflow quicker and more efficient.  

MARKETING ASSISTANT
This AI Chatbot helps you generate ad copy, research insights, SEO keywords, product names, and brand taglines. You can also create engaging social posts, captions, and retweets for Facebook, X, and Instagram with a smart AI caption generator.  

REAL-TIME SEARCH
Powered by GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, Grok-4.5, Gemini Flash 3.5, and DeepSeek V4, this feature lets you instantly access the latest information online. From breaking news to niche queries, Chat Smith keeps you updated and informed.

AI HOMEWORK HELPER
Prep for quizzes, get homework answers, and generate notes with a study assistant. Built on GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini Flash 3.5, and Claude Sonnet 5, Chat Smith also provides a powerful AI Math Solver to help students tackle math problems with step-by-step explanations.

TEXT & VIDEO SUMMARIZER
Summarize PDFs, documents, notes, and YouTube videos instantly. Translate, rewrite, and extract key insights in seconds.

AI TRANSLATOR & LANGUAGE PRACTICE
Translate any languages using powerful multilingual capabilities. Perfect for travel, learning, and everyday conversations.

IMAGE ANALYZER
Upload any photo for instant image analysis. Identify objects, places, animals, or text with clear explanations.  

TEXT TO SPEECH
Convert text into human-like audio with advanced AI voice technology.  

AI KEYBOARD
Type faster with AI-powered grammar fixes, predictive typing, auto replies, and autocorrect.

GRAMMAR & SPELLING CHECKER
Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation with AI proofreading tools.  

RESUME & CV BUILDER
Generate resume, cover letter, LinkedIn optimization, and interview questions with a built-in AI resume checker.  

MOBILE-WEB SYNC
Use Chat Smith on mobile and web with seamless cross-device sync.  

You can subscribe to our auto-renewing plans: weekly ($6.99), monthly ($9.99), or yearly ($49.99). After the free trial, payment is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Unused trial portions are forfeited after purchase. Manage your subscription in your iTunes Account settings.
